en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a gently rising street lined with multi‑storey buildings and trees. On the left is a fenced property with a half‑timbered house; on the right, long residential blocks follow the curve of the road. A few pedestrians, including a woman with a child and a person pushing a cart or pram, walk along the sidewalk. At the top center in red print is the caption indicating the scene is in Meissen and refers to the Rauhental – Schweizerhaus area.
